turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Hi Chris Bellamy, welcome in! Thanks for scheduling a tour with us today.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: So tell me, what's prompting you to look into this now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Honestly our old unit finally gave out last week.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: For the package we discussed, the total cost is $6,800.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's a bit more than I expected, it feels too expensive.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: I understand, it is an investment. We do have financing options if that helps.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Why don't I send over the paperwork and we can follow up in a few days?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright, we can look at it.
